tools.name: research_site
tools.description: Free early-access standalone site research. Query Google ads by domain or advertiser, public Meta ads by keyword, AdSense accounts/related sites, outbound page links, collected ad text, recorded website opportunities or DR changes. Source acquisition is explicit and bounded; all these tools spend 0

tools.name: get_research_workspace
tools.description: Read the caller saved research, folders, private notes, tool history, publisher/ad monitors and in-app change notifications. Free; 0 points. Account ownership comes from the authenticated key.

tools.name: save_research
tools.description: Save a standalone site-tool query in the caller workspace, with a folder and private notes. Free; 0 points.

tools.name: monitor_research
tools.description: Monitor a Google Ads or AdSense query daily or weekly. Record newly observed public ads and connected sites as private in-app notifications. The first successful observation establishes a baseline. Free; 0 points.

tools.name: manage_research
tools.description: Manage the caller private research: remove a saved target, pause/resume or change daily/weekly monitoring, remove a monitor, check current public data, or mark a change notification read. Use IDs from get_research_workspace. Free; 0 points.

tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description: Read a cached Vaneform domain snapshot: scale (full-site or search visits), registry, site profile, and link-rank popularity. Optional include=baidu is cached Baidu rank. Optional include=search is Pro-only keyword rankings (ranked keywords, landing pages, search competitors) from this month's cache

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the caller plan, website lookup allowance, and point balance. This call spends 0. Use before a batch.

tools.name: lookup_keyword
tools.description: Read a US/EN keyword brief: monthly searches, difficulty, CPC, and Google occupancy. Pro-only. At most 30 Google results. A cache hit is free; a successful miss spends 4 points. After trimming, longer than 200 characters is invalid. Matching uses the lowercased, space-collapsed first 80 characters.

tools.name: compare_bulk
tools.description: Compare domains side by side. Returns scale and registry. Fetches traffic when monthly visits are missing. Spends 0 points. Up to 30 domains. Use for 批量对比.

tools.name: compare_tld
tools.description: Compare the same registrable name across suffixes. Default suffixes are com,ai,io. example.com is read as example. Response suffixes and items follow a fixed suffix order; match the returned suffixes. Fetches traffic when monthly visits are missing. Spends 0 points. Use for 后缀对比.
